turns.text: I did! I made a blended fruit puree served in a dish and topped with sliced bananas and hemp seeds. It's nice to eat it with a spoon instead of rushing out with a travel mug.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: There's nothing quite like that DIY guitar sound to keep the creative energy flowing. Did you hear anything from your brother Kwame recently? How is he liking Atlanta?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He's doing great! He actually texted me yesterday. He's finally getting used to the humidity down there and has found a few favorite local spots already. I'm hoping to visit him sometime, though my schedule as a junior architect keeps me pretty anchored here for now.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: It's wonderful that he's settling in so well, though I imagine you miss having him closer. Speaking of staying anchored in Minneapolis, have you been able to take your camera out lately for some photography, or has work kept you entirely indoors?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I actually took a few shots of the skyline over the weekend during a quick walk. The late summer light has been really beautiful here. I haven't had time to edit them yet, but I'm looking forward to sitting down with them later this week.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That late August light in Minnesota is really special. I'd love to hear how those photos turn out once you get a chance to look at them. What are your plans for the rest of this evening?

turns.text: Just a quiet evening at home with Leah. We'll probably just catch up on our days and maybe read a bit before calling it a night. It's been a productive day, so I'm looking forward to relaxing.
